# keyUsage + id-RSASSA-PSS single-certificate vectors for the provider cert checks.
# Self-signed, parsed in isolation (no chain/signature validation). ku_* differ only
# in the keyUsage extension; ku_none_cert omits it (unrestricted). rsapss_cert has an
# id-RSASSA-PSS SubjectPublicKeyInfo (OID 1.2.840.113549.1.1.10); rsa_normal_cert and
# the ku_* certs use rsaEncryption / ecPublicKey keys.
ku_digsig_
ku_keyenc_
ku_keyagree_
ku_none_
rsa_normal_
rsapss_
